शुण्ठ् शुण्ठ्, cl. 1. P. शुण्ठति, शुण्ठितुम्,
to limp, be lame [cf. rt. शुठ् above]; to
dry, grow dry, be or become dry; cl. 10. P. शुण्ठ-
यति, -यितुम्, to dry, become dry.

शुण्ठाचार्य, अस्, m., N. of a chief priest of Śiva
(in the Dhūrta-nartaka).
शुण्ठि, इस्, or शुण्ठी, f. dry ginger.

शुण्ड् शुण्ड्, cl. 1. P. शुण्डति, &c., to
break; to disturb, harass, vex, torment.

शुण्ड, अस्, m. (probably connected with the pre-
ceding rt.), the juice exuding from the temples of an
elephant in rut; an elephant's trunk; (आ), f. spirituous
liquor; a place where spirituous liquor is sold, a
tavern; an elephant's proboscis or trunk; the stalk
of the lotus; a harlot, prostitute, bawd; a particular
animal (perhaps a water-elephant or hippopotamus).
—शुण्ड-रोह, अस्, m. a kind of grass (= भू-
तृण).
—शुण्डा-पान, अम्, n. a place where spirits
are drunk or sold, a tavern, dram-shop.
—शुण्डा-
रोचनी, f. a species of plant (= रोचनिका).

शुण्डक, अस्, m. a distiller or seller of spirituous
liquors; a military flute or fife (= युद्ध-वेणु).

शुण्डार, अस्, m. a distiller, vintner; an elephant's
trunk.

शुण्डाल, अस्, m. ‘possessing a proboscis or trunk,’
an elephant.

शुण्डिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing spirituous liquor;
having a proboscis; (ई), m. a distiller, preparer and
seller of spirituous liquors; an elephant.
—शुण्डि-
मूषिका, f. the musk-rat or shrew.

शुण्डी, f. a swelling or enlargement of any gland
[cf. कण्ठ-श्˚, गल-श्˚]; the plant Heliotropium
Indicum (= हस्ति-शुण्डी).
सुणहासफ सुणहासफ, N. of a place.
